blocks.label: About this form
blocks.content: Every rule on this form beyond required and the date format is a host validator from src/validation/validators.mjs. The page and the API import that same module.

blocks.label: Medical record number (MRN)
blocks.description: "MRN" then 8 digits, the last a check digit. Try MRN12345674 (valid) or MRN12345675 (wrong check digit).

blocks.label: Ward code
blocks.description: Test only: enter "throw" to make this field's validator throw.

blocks.label: Discharge date
blocks.description: Must be after the admission date.

blocks.label: Stopped
blocks.description: On or after the start date, and not after discharge.
